---
title: "Stop a wrap early"
description: "An empty wrap-clear div ends the wrap before the next paragraph."
format:
  html: default
  pdf: default
  typst:
    output-file: wrap-clear-typst.pdf
  docx: default
---

An empty `wrap-clear` div after a paragraph ends the wrap there:

```markdown
![Mean ratings by condition.](ratings.png){#fig-ratings .wrap-right width="35%"}

Only this paragraph sits beside the figure.

::: {.wrap-clear}
:::

This paragraph starts below the figure.
```

## Result

![Mean ratings by condition.](../images/ratings.png){#fig-ratings .wrap-right width="35%"}

Only this paragraph sits beside @fig-ratings. The `wrap-clear` div comes
right after it.

::: {.wrap-clear}
:::

This paragraph comes after the `wrap-clear` div, so it starts below the
figure and runs the full width of the text. Without the div, it would sit
beside the figure too.

Use the div to keep text that belongs to the next topic away from the
figure.
